messages:
Maya (Product): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on pipeline + GTM + partners. Need to clarify partner-led vs direct targets, revenue crediting, and partner-enabled onboarding SLA.

Ravi (Sales): Short answers: target for next quarter ~60/40 partner-led:direct for enterprise. Crediting baseline = referral 30% Y1 unless co-sell recorded. Legal/RevOps to finalize.

Ben (GTM): I've published a partner-centric pipeline dashboard (internal): https://redwood.app/dashboards/partner-pipeline Beta. Filters: partner_tag, origin, ARR. I'll make a saved "Leadership" view and share.

Elena (Partnerships): Enablement update: partner onboarding kit goes live next Tue — playbook, pricing FAQ, joint demo checklist, tech integration checklist. Aim to validate with 2 pilot partners.

Priya (Rev Ops): On crediting paperwork: drafting a referral addendum template. Example clause for review: `Partner referral fee = 30% of first-year invoiced revenue, payable net 30 after collection, subject to cancellations.` Draft by Wednesday.

Allison (CEO): Strategic note: prioritize partners that unlock regulated verticals (healthcare, finance). We'll assign AM headcount to top 5 partners. Can onboarding compress from ~8 weeks to ~4 weeks? Elena thoughts?

Elena (Partnerships): Compression possible if Sales + Product agree to a baked POA. Proposed timeline: 3 weeks enablement (playbook + demo training) + 1 week tech onboarding for MVP.

Maya (Product): Roadmap question: will Product add partner-specific routing/policy metadata (e.g., route-by-partner-SLA)? Need scope and priority.

Ravi (Sales): This is high priority for sales motions. Ben, can you confirm MVP scope and ETA?

Ben (GTM): MVP scope: partner tags, routing config, partner SLA metadata, saved pipeline view. ETA: internal beta by end of Q3. Plan canary with Partner A.

Maya (Product): Who will own rollout comms and playbook edits?

Priya (Rev Ops): I'll own comms and playbook updates. Need final assets from Partnerships and tech notes from Product.

Elena (Partnerships): Will post slides + onboarding checklist in #partners channel in ~30m. @Priya assign follow-ups there.

deploy-bot: Slides uploaded: https://redwood.app/files/allhands-q3-partners.pdf

Ravi (Sales): One remaining nuance: how to credit a partner that introduced the deal upstream but isn't on the final contract? Current rules unclear.

Allison (CEO): Decision: institute an "influence" credit. If partner generated the first qualified touch, assign 20% influence credit unless documented co-sell. We'll formalize in partner policy.

Maya (Product): Action items recap: Ben to share saved dashboard view (done), Elena to post enablement assets (~30m), Priya to deliver referral addendum draft by Wed, Allison to approve influence policy for partner docs. Leaving thread open for quick clarifications. :thumbsup:
